Man assaulted in Haridwar for meeting woman friend of different faith

A Muslim man was reportedly assaulted and humiliated in Haridwar, Uttarakhand, after being accused of meeting a Hindu woman friend. Reports indicate he was tied with a dog leash around his neck and beaten. The incident has drawn attention to interfaith relationships and mob violence.
